text:
alex_k: Quick gate check — planning to cut the DevEx release (SDK v1.5.0 + sample apps v0.9) tomorrow 10:00 PT. Changelog cutoff = 09:00 PT. Please call out any hard blockers or ownership gaps by EOD today.

maria_dev: Are we still blocked on the runtime streaming param rename? I saw a @vikram note earlier.

vikram: Yes — eng-runtime landed the rename in a draft PR but needs one more tiny test. ETA ~02:00 PT. If that lands we can keep streaming enabled; otherwise we fallback to legacy stream flag.

sara_eng: CI is flaky on the sampleapp e2e for the mac matrix — 3/8 failed this morning. I filed #devex-sample-e2e and attached logs. Short term: we can skip mac in the release smoke if owners ok. :grimacing:

tim_p: Skipping mac is OK for feature parity, but we should document the exception in the changelog and flag follow-up ticket to re-enable post-release.

priya_docs: Noted. I'll add a short note under "Known issues" and include the follow-up ticket link. Can someone confirm the exact npm package name/version?

alex_k: SDK package: @redwood/devex-sdk@1.5.0. Sample apps tagged as devex-sample@0.9.0. Release steps (shorthand):
```
# build & publish SDK
pnpm install && pnpm -w run build && npm publish dist/sdk --access public
# tag sample apps
git tag -a v0.9.0 -m "sample apps v0.9.0" && git push origin v0.9.0
```
(Full playbook: https://redwood.internal/devex/release-playbook)

maria_dev: Quick ask — changelog entries: I have the SDK API changes, @priay_docs can you line-edit for tone? Also need one-liner for the streaming param rename.

vikram: Draft changelog note: "rename: streamingFlag -> streaming_mode (backwards-compatible fallback)". Will post PR to runtime repo with upgrade notes.

priya_docs: Will review edits in the changelog PR this afternoon. Can someone assign the PR to me?

alex_k: Assigned to @priay_docs and @maria_dev. Ownership matrix for release:
- SDK publish: @maria_dev
- Sample apps tagging + docker push: @sara_eng
- Changelog + release notes: @priay_docs
- Smoke/rollback check: @tim_p
- Runtime compatibility validation: @vikram

sara_eng: For docker push, we need credentials rotated for CI — opened infra ticket #INF-413. If rotation is delayed past 06:00 PT tomorrow we'll fallback to a manual push from my laptop.

tim_p: Manual push plan ok, but call out that manual publish requires rebuild of the smoke image. I'll prepare a one-step checklist for manual flow and paste it here.

devex-bot: Reminder: changelog cutoff in 1 hour (09:00 PT). Please mark PRs as "release-ready" to be included.

maria_dev: One last dependency: sample app uses new quantized model artifact from eng-ml — they've promised the artifact by 04:00 PT. If that misses, sample app will build against v1 artifact and still pass tests, but perf numbers will differ. Need signoff on bundling fallback.

alex_k: Acceptable to bundle fallback artifact — add a "perf note" in the release notes. We should NOT block the release on perf parity.

priya_docs: I'll prepare the perf note and link to follow-up ticket. Also will highlight the mac e2e skip and runtime rename fallback.

vikram: I'll post a short script to validate runtime compatibility post-publish and attach it to the playbook.

sara_eng: OK, I'll triage the mac e2e flakes and if they're non-actionable today we'll skip mac for the release pipeline and create a P0 for Monday.

tim_p: Final checklist status: all owners acknowledged. I have smoke run template ready and will run it at 10:15 PT after publish.

alex_k: Thanks team. Action items for EOD: everyone update their PRs + mark release-ready; @vikram and eng-runtime to land compatibility test; @sara_eng confirm CI creds or manual push plan; @priay_docs and @maria_dev finalize changelog. We'll reconvene async at 08:30 PT for a pre-cut sanity pulse.

maria_dev: Acknowledged.

vikram: Acknowledged, will ping when tests green.

sara_eng: Acknowledged, will update infra ticket or post manual push note.

priya_docs: Acknowledged, will open the changelog PR in ~30m.

tim_p: Acknowledged, prepping smoke checklist.

devex-bot: Note: release window opens 10:00 PT tomorrow; automated deploy step will attempt 3 retries on failure."
